personality_one_liner: A high-performance, command-center interface that feels like professional esports analytics software—sharp, data-driven, and authoritative.

spacing.rule: Use intentional padding around content blocks to separate data visually. Keep spacing tight within components for information density, but generous between separate modular widgets.

do's: Use solid dark surfaces (surfaceSecondary/surfaceTertiary) instead of glass for maximum readability and performance, fitting the utility/esports aesthetic.
dont's: Do not use blur/glass on cards, modal backgrounds, or general headers. Rely on solid colors and borders for elevation.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A modular dashboard hub providing quick access to all key sections and high-level platform status.

states.error: Readable error message with a retry button centered on screen.

screens.layout: Top Header with Logo/Title. Main body consists of modular cards for 'Featured Meta', 'Upcoming Tournaments', and 'Recent Teams' acting as entry points. Use a 4-tab Bottom Tab Bar: Home, Meta, Tournaments, Menu.

screens.name: Meta

states.empty: 'Coming Soon' state featuring an abstract tech data visualization illustration, a brief descriptive text of what's coming, and a primary CTA to return home.

screens.layout: List-based structure inside surfaceSecondary cards, currently locked in a 'Coming Soon' state.

screens.name: Tournaments
screens.purpose: Placeholder for tournament list and bracket browser.

states.empty: 'Coming Soon' state featuring a dark esports arena background illustration.

screens.layout: Grid or vertical list of tournament cards with date/status badges.

screens.name: Menu (More)
screens.purpose: A navigation hub for secondary tools (Team Builder, Damage Calc, Analyzer, VGC Guide) that don't fit in the bottom tabs.
screens.layout: A sleek vertical list of large navigation tiles/rows. Each row should have a leading icon, a title, a brief description, and a trailing chevron.

hero_stadium.alt: Dark esports stadium arena at night

coming_soon_tech.alt: Abstract neon data lines forming a digital landscape

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the foundation of VGC Intelligence using a rigid, professional esports layout inspired by Faceit/Liquipedia. Avoid playful, rounded UI or childish graphics.
Implement navigation using a Bottom Tab Bar with 4 items: Home, Meta, Tournaments, and 'Menu'.
The 'Menu' tab should open a screen containing navigation rows for the remaining 5 sections (Teams, Team Builder, Damage Calculator, Analyzer, VGC Guide).
Use Rajdhani for all numbers, metrics, and major headings to give it a technical HUD feel. Use Inter for standard readable UI copy.

All placeholder screens (Meta, Tournaments, etc.) MUST show a well-designed 'Coming Soon' empty state. These should fill the screen flex:1, feature an abstract dark background image (from the images object) overlayed with a gradient-to-dark scrim, a descriptive text, and a primary call-to-action button.
Do not use glassmorphism. Use solid dark colors (surface, surfaceSecondary) and subtle 1px borders (border, borderStrong) to separate elements and ensure maximum data legibility.
Ensure all interactive elements have haptic feedback connected to their onPress events.
